# PROTEIN CREATION RULES ### PROTEIN DESTRUCTION RULES ##DUM(L~C) + MPF(B,DP~U~P,S~no) -> DUM(L~C) kMPFout# SPONTANEOUS ACTIVATION OF CDC25b ##

CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~U,T~B) -> CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P,T~B)

CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~D,T~B) -> CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P,T~B)

CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~U,T~B) -> CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P,T~B)

CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~D,T~B) -> CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P,T~B)

# ACTIVATION OF Cdc25b BY CDC25a ##

CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~U,T~B) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P,T~A) -> CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P,T~B) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P,T~A)

CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~D,T~B) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P,T~A) -> CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P,T~B) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P,T~A)

CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~U,T~B) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P,T~A) -> CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P,T~B) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P,T~A)

CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~D,T~B) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P,T~A) -> CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P,T~B) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P,T~A)

# ACTIVATION OF MPF BY Cdc25's ##

MPF(B,DP~P,S~no,L~C) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P) <-> MPF(B!0,DP~P,S~Su,L~C).CDC25(B!0,L~C,S~Ph,AP~P)

MPF(B!0,DP~P,S~Su,L~C).CDC25(B!0,L~C,S~Ph,AP~P) -> MPF(B,DP~U,S~no,L~C) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P)

MPF(B,DP~P,S~no,L~N) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) <-> MPF(B!0,DP~P,S~Su,L~N).CDC25(B!0,S~Ph,AP~P,L~N)

MPF(B!0,DP~P,S~Su,L~N).CDC25(B!0,S~Ph,AP~P,L~N) -> MPF(B,DP~U,S~no,L~N) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P)

# ACTIVATION OF MPF BY Cdc25c ##

MPF(B,DP~P,S~no,L~C) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P,T~C) <-> MPF(B!0,DP~P,S~Su,L~C).CDC25(B!0,L~C,S~Ph,AP~P,T~C)

MPF(B!0,DP~P,S~Su,L~C).CDC25(B!0,L~C,S~Ph,AP~P,T~C) -> MPF(B,DP~U,S~no,L~C) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P,T~C)

MPF(B,DP~P,S~no,L~N) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P,T~C) <-> MPF(B!0,DP~P,S~Su,L~N).CDC25(B!0,S~Ph,AP~P,T~C,L~N)

MPF(B!0,DP~P,S~Su,L~N).CDC25(B!0,S~Ph,AP~P,L~N,T~C) -> MPF(B,DP~U,S~no,L~N) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P,T~C)

# SPONTANEOUS DEACTIVATION OF CDC25's ##

CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,T~C,AP~P) + DUM(L~C) -> CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,T~C,AP~U) + DUM(L~C)

CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,T~C,AP~P) + DUM(L~N) -> CDC25(B,S~no,T~C,AP~U,L~N) + DUM(L~N)

# DEGRADATION OF SEQUESTERED CDC25's ### ACTIVATION OF Cdc25c BY MPF ##

MPF(B,L~N,DP~U,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~U,T~C) <-> MPF(B!0,L~N,DP~U,S~Ki).CDC25(B!0,L~N,S~Su,AP~U,T~C)

MPF(B!0,L~N,DP~U,S~Ki).CDC25(B!0,L~N,S~Su,AP~U,T~C) -> MPF(B,L~N,DP~U,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P,T~C)

MPF(B,L~C,DP~U,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~U,T~C) <-> MPF(B!0,L~C,DP~U,S~Ki).CDC25(B!0,L~C,S~Su,AP~U,T~C)

MPF(B!0,L~C,DP~U,S~Ki).CDC25(B!0,L~C,S~Su,AP~U,T~C)->MPF(B,L~C,DP~U,S~no)+CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,SD~*,AP~P,T~C) kCDCa

MPF(B!0,L~C,DP~U,S~Ki).CDC25(B!0,L~C,S~Su,AP~U,T~C) -> MPF(B,L~C,DP~U,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P,T~C)

# DEACTIVATION OF Wee1 BY MPF ##

MPF(B,L~N,DP~U,S~no) + WEE1(B,L~N,DP~U,S~no) <-> MPF(B!0,L~N,DP~U,S~Ki).WEE1(B!0,L~N,DP~U,S~Su)

# PIN1 Destruction of Wee1 ### DEACTIVATION OF MPF BY WEE1 AND pkMYT1 ### PHOSPHORYLATION OF MPF CYTOPLASMIC RETENTION SITE BY UNKOWN KINASE ### CHK1 AND CHK2 ENABLING SEQUESTERATION OF CDC25 ##

CHK1(B,AP~P,S~no,L~C) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,SD~U,SE~U) <-> CHK1(B!0,AP~P,S~Ki,L~C).CDC25(B!0,L~C,SD~U,SE~U,S~Su)

CHK1(B,AP~P,S~no,L~N) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,SD~U,SE~U) <-> CHK1(B!0,AP~P,S~Ki,L~N).CDC25(B!0,L~N,SD~U,SE~U,S~Su)

CHK1(B!0,AP~P,S~Ki,L~C).CDC25(B!0,L~C,SD~U,SE~U,S~Su) -> CHK1(B,AP~P,S~no,L~C) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,SD~U,SE~P)

CHK1(B!0,AP~P,S~Ki,L~N).CDC25(B!0,L~N,SD~U,SE~U,S~Su) -> CHK1(B,AP~P,S~no,L~N) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,SD~U,SE~P)

CHK2(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,SD~U,SE~U) <-> CHK2(B!0,L~C,S~Ki,AP~P).CDC25(B!0,L~C,SD~U,SE~U,S~Su)

CHK2(B!0,L~C,S~Ki,AP~P).CDC25(B!0,L~C,SD~U,SE~U,S~Su) -> CHK2(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,SD~U,SE~P)

CHK2(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,SD~U,SE~U) <-> CHK2(B!0,L~N,S~Ki,AP~P).CDC25(B!0,L~N,SD~U,SE~U,S~Su)

CHK2(B!0,L~N,S~Ki,AP~P).CDC25(B!0,L~N,SD~U,SE~U,S~Su) -> CHK2(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,SD~U,SE~P)

# SUPERACTIVATION OF Wee1 BY CHK1 ### PP2A REMOVING SEQUESTRATION ENABLING PHOSPHORYLATION FROM CDC25's ##

PP2A(B,L~C,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,SE~P) <-> PP2A(B!0,L~C,S~Ph).CDC25(B!0,L~C,S~Su,SE~P)

PP2A(B!0,L~C,S~Ph).CDC25(B!0,L~C,S~Su,SE~P) -> PP2A(B,L~C,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,SE~U)

PP2A(B,L~N,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,SE~P) <-> PP2A(B!0,S~Ph,L~N).CDC25(B!0,L~N,S~Su,SE~P)

PP2A(B!0,S~Ph,L~N).CDC25(B!0,L~N,S~Su,SE~P) -> PP2A(B,L~N,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,SE~U)

# PP2A DISRUPTING 14-3-3 SEQUESTERATION OF CDC25's ### PP2A REMOVING THE SEQUESTERATION DISABLING PHOSPHORYLATION FROM CDC25's ##

PP2A(B,L~C,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,SD~P) -> PP2A(B,L~C,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,SD~U)

PP2A(B,L~C,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,SD~P) -> PP2A(B,L~C,S~no) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,SD~U)

# 14-3-3 SEQUESTERING CDC25's ##

CDC25(B!0,L~C,SD~U,S~Sq,SE~P).E33(B!0,L~C,S~no,Sq~N) -> CDC25(B!0,L~C,SD~U,S~Sq,SE~P).E33(B!0,L~C,S~no,Sq~Y)

CDC25(B!0,L~N,SD~U,S~Sq,SE~P).E33(B!0,L~N,S~no,Sq~N) -> CDC25(B!0,L~C,SD~U,S~Sq,SE~P).E33(B!0,L~C,S~no,Sq~Y)

# CHK1 AND CHK2 PHOSPHORYLATION OF CDC25a LEADING TO DEGRADATION ### CHK1 DEACTIVATION OF CDC25b ### NUCLEAR IMPORT AND EXPORT RULES ##

Importin(L~M) + E33(B,Sq~N,S~no,L~C) -> Importin(L~M) + E33(B,Sq~N,S~no,L~N)

DUM(L~M) + E33(B,Sq~N,S~no,L~N) -> DUM(L~M) + E33(B,Sq~N,S~no,L~C)

Importin(L~M) + CHK1(B,S~no,L~C) -> Importin(L~M) + CHK1(B,S~no,L~N)

DUM(L~M) + CHK1(B,S~no,L~N) -> DUM(L~M) + CHK1(B,S~no,L~C)

Importin(L~M) + CHK2(B,S~no,L~C) -> Importin(L~M) + CHK2(B,S~no,L~N)

DUM(L~M) + CHK2(B,AP~P,S~no,L~N) -> DUM(L~M) + CHK2(B,AP~P,S~no,L~C)

Importin(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,T~A) -> Importin(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,T~A)

Importin(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,T~B) -> Importin(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,T~B)

CRM1(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,T~A) -> CRM1(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,T~A)

CRM1(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,T~B) -> CRM1(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,T~B)

Importin(L~M,CdcFI~N) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,T~C) -> Importin(L~M,CdcFI~N) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,,T~C)

Importin(L~M,CdcFI~Y) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,T~C) -> Importin(L~M,CdcFI~Y) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,T~C)

CRM1(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,T~C,SD~P) -> CRM1(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,T~C,SD~P)

CRM1(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,T~C,SD~U) -> CRM1(L~M) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,T~C,SD~U)

PLK1(B,L~N,S~no) + CRM1(L~M) -> PLK1(B,L~C,S~no) + CRM1(L~M)

PLK1(B,L~C,S~no) + Importin(L~M) -> PLK1(B,L~N,S~no) + Importin(L~M)

CRM1(L~M) + MPF(B,L~N,NE~U,S~no) -> CRM1(L~M) + MPF(B,L~C,NE~U,S~no)

CRM1(L~M) + MPF(B,L~N,NE~P,S~no) -> CRM1(L~M) + MPF(B,L~C,NE~P,S~no)

Importin(L~M) + MPF(B,L~C,NE~U,NE2~U,CR~P,S~no) -> Importin(L~M) + MPF(B,L~N,NE~U,NE2~U,CR~P,S~no)

Importin(L~M) + MPF(B,L~C,NE~U,NE2~U,CR~U,S~no) -> Importin(L~M) + MPF(B,L~N,NE~U,NE2~U,CR~U,S~no)

Importin(L~M) + MPF(B,L~C,NE2~P,CR~P,S~no) -> Importin(L~M) + MPF(B,L~N,NE2~P,CR~P,S~no)

Importin(L~M) + MPF(B,L~C,NE2~P,CR~U,S~no) -> Importin(L~M) + MPF(B,L~N,NE2~P,CR~U,S~no)

Importin(L~M) + MPF(B,L~C,NE~P,NE2~U,CR~U,S~no) -> Importin(L~M) + MPF(B,L~N,NE~P,NE2~U,CR~U,S~no)

# MODIFICATION OF IMPORTIN FOR FAST TRANSPORT ##

Importin(L~M,CdcFI~N) + MPF(B,L~C,DP~U,CR~U,S~no) -> Importin(L~M,CdcFI~Y) + MPF(B,L~C,DP~U,CR~U,S~no)

DUM(L~M) + Importin(L~M,CdcFI~Y) -> DUM(L~M) + Importin(L~M,CdcFI~N)

# CHK1 AND CHK2 SPONTANEOUS DEACTIVATION ##

CHK1(B,AP~P,S~no) + DUM(L~C) -> CHK1(B,AP~U,S~no) + DUM(L~C)

CHK2(B,S~no,AP~P) + DUM(L~C) -> CHK2(B,S~no,AP~U) + DUM(L~C)

# CHK1 AND CHK2 SPONTANEOUS ACTIVATION ##

CHK2(B,S~no,AP~U) -> CHK2(B,S~no,AP~P)

# REMOVAL OF MPF CYTOPLASMIC RETENTION PHOSPHORYLATION BY CDC25's ##

PLK1(B!0,L~C,S~Ki,AP~P).CDC25(B!0,L~C,SD~U,S~Su) -> PLK1(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P) + CDC25(B,L~C,S~no,SD~P)

PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,SD~U) <-> PLK1(B!0,L~N,AP~P,S~Ki).CDC25(B!0,L~N,S~Su,SD~U)

PLK1(B!0,L~N,S~Ki,AP~P).CDC25(B!0,L~N,SD~U,S~Su) -> PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + CDC25(B,L~N,S~no,SD~P)

# Plk1 PHOSPHORYLATING MPF ##

PLK1(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P) + MPF(B,L~C,NE~U,NE2~U,S~no) <-> PLK1(B!0,AP~P,L~C,S~Ki).MPF(B!0,L~C,S~Su,NE~U,NE2~U)

PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + MPF(B,L~N,S~no,NE~U,NE2~P) <-> PLK1(B!0,L~N,AP~P,S~Ki).MPF(B!0,L~N,NE~U,NE2~P,S~Su)

PLK1(B!0,L~C,S~Ki,AP~P).MPF(B!0,L~C,NE~U,S~Su) -> PLK1(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P) + MPF(B,L~C,S~no,NE~P)

PLK1(B!0,L~N,S~Ki,AP~P).MPF(B!0,L~N,NE~U,S~Su) -> PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + MPF(B,L~N,S~no,NE~P)

# MPF PHOSPHORYLATING Plk1 ##

PLK1(B,L~C,S~no,AP~U) + MPF(B,L~C,S~no,DP~U) <-> PLK1(B!0,L~C,S~Su,AP~U).MPF(B!0,L~C,S~Ki,DP~U)

PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~U) + MPF(B,L~N,S~no,DP~U) <-> PLK1(B!0,L~N,S~Su,AP~U).MPF(B!0,L~N,S~Ki,DP~U)

PLK1(B!0,L~N,S~Su,AP~U).MPF(B!0,L~N,S~Ki,DP~U) -> PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + MPF(B,L~N,S~no,DP~U)

PLK1(B!0,L~C,S~Su,AP~U).MPF(B!0,L~C,S~Ki,DP~U) -> PLK1(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P) + MPF(B,L~C,S~no,DP~U)

# Plk1 PHOSPHORYLATING CHK1 ##

PLK1(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P) + CHK1(B,AP~P,S~no,L~C) -> PLK1(B,L~C,S~no,AP~U) + CHK1(B,AP~P,S~no,L~C)

PLK1(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P) + CHK1(B,AP~P,S~no,L~C) -> PLK1(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P) + CHK1(B,AP~U,S~no,L~C)

PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + CHK1(B,AP~P,S~no,L~N) -> PLK1(B,S~no,AP~U,L~N) + CHK1(B,AP~P,S~no,L~N)

PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + CHK1(B,AP~P,S~no,L~N) -> PLK1(B,S~no,AP~P,L~N) + CHK1(B,AP~U,S~no,L~N)

#PLK1 PHOSPHORYLATING WEE1##

PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + WEE1(B,L~N,DP~U,S~no) <-> PLK1(B!0,L~N,S~no,AP~P).WEE1(B!0,L~N,DP~U,S~no)

PLK1(B!0,L~N,S~no,AP~P).WEE1(B!0,L~N,DP~U,S~no) -> PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + WEE1(B,L~N,DP~P,S~no)

PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + WEE1(B,L~N,DP~M,S~no) <-> PLK1(B!0,L~N,S~no,AP~P).WEE1(B!0,L~N,DP~M,S~no)

PLK1(B!0,L~N,S~no,AP~P).WEE1(B!0,L~N,DP~M,S~no) -> PLK1(B,L~N,S~no,AP~P) + WEE1(B,L~N,DP~P,S~no)

# Plk1 PHOSPHORYLATING pkMyt1 ##

PLK1(B,L~C,S~no,AP~P) + MYT1(B,S~no,L~C) <-> PLK1(B!0,L~C,AP~P,S~Ki).MYT1(B!0,L~C,S~Su)

# MPF AUTOPHOSPHORYLATION ##

MPF(B!0,L~N,NE2~U,S~Su).MPF(B!0,L~N,DP~U,S~Ki) -> MPF(B,L~N,S~no,NE2~P) + MPF(B,L~N,DP~U,S~no)

MPF(B,L~N,S~no,NE2~U) + MPF(B,L~N,DP~U,S~no) <-> MPF(B!0,L~N,NE2~U,S~Su).MPF(B!0,L~N,DP~U,S~Ki)

MPF(B,L~C,NE2~U,S~no) + MPF(B,L~C,DP~U,S~no) <-> MPF(B!0,L~C,NE2~U,S~Su).MPF(B!0,L~C,DP~U,S~Ki)

MPF(B!0,L~C,NE2~U,S~Su).MPF(B!0,L~C,DP~U,S~Ki) -> MPF(B,L~C,NE2~P,S~no) + MPF(B,L~C,DP~U,S~no)

# Phosphorylation of Histone H3 by MPF to Mark Mitotic Entry ##

MPF(B,DP~U,L~N,S~no) + H3(B,AP~U,L~N,S~no) <-> MPF(B!0,DP~U,L~N,S~Ki).H3(B!0,AP~U,L~N,S~Su)

MPF(B!0,DP~U,L~N,S~Ki).H3(B!0,AP~U,L~N,S~Su) -> MPF(B,DP~U,L~N,S~no) + H3(B,AP~P,L~N,S~no)
